items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: 'I Hear Music', Billie Holiday, with Teddy Wilson, Roy Eldridge, Al Hall, John Collins, guitar.

ctx.x: John, maybe we should write a book.

Here's the one I did with Tad Dameron, 'John's Delight.' I wrote this one, you know. Let's see, who's featured on the record. They don't give you the personnel of the band, only who was featured on the record. It's Tad Dameron, piano, J. J. Johnson, trombone, and John Collins, guitar, featured. Okay. On the other side is focus. They only give the featured artist, Cecil Payne, baritone, J. J. Johnson, trombone, John Collins, guitar. How can they do this to me? I won't tell you how many records I made with Slam…
